title: Recursive Hierarchical Network System (RHNS): A Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Recursive, Governed, Multi-Agent Reasoning
description: This deposit documents the original RHNS (Recursive Hierarchical Network System) architecture conceived and authored by Garrett Carrol of Garcar Enterprise. RHNS is a recursive neuro-symbolic architecture for governed multi-agent reasoning, hierarchical planning, memory integration, symbolic grounding, and reusable skill synthesis. Prior art established April 27, 2026. Public prior-art disclosure establishing authorship and timestamped architectural precedence.
